description: Change a check's settings. Only the fields you pass change; the others keep their current values. Its type cannot change. To pause or resume use pause_check / resume_check.

assertions.description: http only: conditions a response must meet. [] = any response that arrives counts as up.

value.description: A string, also for numbers: status_code "200", max_latency_ms "500", body_contains the expected substring, header the expected value.

cron_expression.description: cron checks only: the job's schedule, 5 crontab fields (e.g. "0 3 * * 1-5" = 03:00 on weekdays). The check expects a ping after each scheduled run. Empty or null on update_check removes it (the check then uses interval_seconds).

cron_timezone.description: cron checks only: IANA time zone cron_expression is evaluated in (e.g. "Europe/Paris"). Default UTC. Needs a cron_expression.

failure_threshold.description: Consecutive failed executions before the check goes down (default 2; 1 alerts on a single failure and is discouraged).

grace_seconds.description: SECONDS, not minutes. heartbeat and cron: extra silence allowed after the deadline before the check goes down (e.g. 600 = 10 minutes). Default 0.

interval_seconds.description: SECONDS. http/tls/domain: how often to check. heartbeat: the expected period between pings. Default 300. The plan sets a minimum (Free 300, Starter 60, Pro/Business 30); a lower value is refused.

url.description: http: the http(s) URL to request. tls: an https:// URL, or a bare host or host:port (stored as https://host[:port]). domain: the bare domain name (example.com). Not used by heartbeat and cron.

name: update_check
title: Update a check
